evidence.title: STT GDC India Marks the Groundbreaking of the New Palava Campus
evidence.attribution: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (India) via LinkedIn
evidence.excerpt: STT GDC India reports that it broke ground on the first data centre at its new Palava campus on March 16, 2026, with 50 MW of initial IT-load capacity and an approximately 400 MW campus IT-load plan.
